players.product: GaAs / InP optoelectronic foundry (VCSELs, photodiodes, lasers)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue was NT$5,257 mn, up 15% QoQ and 39% YoY, in line with expectations (company). Reflecting a more favorable product mix and higher shipment volumes, partially offset by margin dilution during the initial ramp-up of new products, individual GM was 32.6% (+0.5 pp QoQ); consolidated GM 28.2% (+1.9 pp) and OPM 14.1% (+4.8 pp). Net income attributable to the parent NT$977 mn (NT$533 mn in Q1 2026), EPS NT$2.30. H1 2026 revenue NT$9,847 million (+34% YoY), EPS NT$3.56.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue NT$5,257 mn (+15% QoQ, +39% YoY); consolidated GM 28.2%; EPS NT$2.30

quarterly_data.signal: Company guidance for Q3 2026: consolidated revenue expected to increase low-teens QoQ; consolidated gross margin expected to be around the level of low-thirties.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue up low-teens QoQ; gross margin around low-thirties

quarterly_data.signal: Approximate utilization was 65% in Q2 2026 (60% in Q1 2026, 45% in Q2 2025); company: as capacity utilization improves, the benefits of product mix optimization are expected to become more evident. Optical rose to 10-15% of Q2 2026 revenue (5-10% in Q1 2026), with Cellular 30-35%, Infrastructure 30-35%, Wi-Fi 10-15%. Project-based capex resumed in 2H25, primarily for Optical and GaN projects; capex NT$129 million in Q2 2026 and NT$1,013 million in H1 2026. Operating cash flow, an inflow for 10 consecutive quarters, shifted to an outflow in Q2 2026 due to an inventory build-up of raw materials; inventories NT$7,584 million at 2026/6/30 (NT$5,140 million at 2026/3/31).
quarterly_data.figure: utilization ~65% in Q2 2026; Optical 10-15% of Q2 2026 revenue; H1 2026 capex NT$1,013 million
